parameters.query:
SELECT
  l.id,
  l.email,
  l.first_name,
  l.last_name,
  l.full_name,
  l.title,
  l.company,
  l.icp_tier        AS tier,
  l.score,
  l.status,
  l.stage,
  l.score_breakdown,
  lb.brief,
  c.industry,
  c.employee_count,
  c.website,
  c.annual_revenue,
  -- last 5 conversation turns
  (
    SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(conv) ORDER BY conv.sent_at DESC)
    FROM (
      SELECT direction, subject, body_text, intent, sentiment, sent_at
      FROM conversations
      WHERE lead_id = l.id
      ORDER BY sent_at DESC
      LIMIT 5
    ) conv
  ) AS recent_conversations,
  -- active sequence info
  s.id              AS sequence_id,
  s.status          AS sequence_status,
  -- existing open escalation count (prevent spam)
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM escalations e2
    WHERE e2.lead_id = l.id AND e2.status = 'pending'
  ) AS open_escalation_count
FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN lead_briefs  lb ON lb.lead_id   = l.id
LEFT JOIN companies    c  ON c.id         = l.company_id
LEFT JOIN sequences    s  ON s.id         = l.sequence_id
WHERE l.id = $1
LIMIT 1;

values.content:
You are an expert B2B sales coach summarizing a lead situation for a human sales rep who needs to take over from an AI agent.

Your briefing must be specific, actionable, and grounded in the facts provided.
NEVER invent details not present in the context.

Output ONLY valid JSON with exactly these keys:
{
  "headline": "one sentence — the single most important thing the rep needs to know right now",
  "bullets": ["5 specific factual points about this lead and situation — names, scores, signals, what was said"],
  "discovery_questions": ["3 specific questions the rep should ask this lead in a call"],
  "recommended_action": "one specific, concrete action the rep should take (e.g. call within 2h, send revised proposal, loop in solutions engineer)",
  "urgency": "HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW",
  "tone_guidance": "one sentence on tone — e.g. they are frustrated, be empathetic; or they are excited, be direct"
}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO activities (type, lead_id, payload, created_at)
VALUES ('escalation_created', $1, $2::jsonb, NOW());

UPDATE escalations
SET
  status       = 'approved',
  resolved_by  = $2,
  resolved_at  = NOW(),
  updated_at   = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING id, lead_id, context;

UPDATE escalations
SET
  status     = 'editing',
  resolved_by = $2,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING id, lead_id, context;

UPDATE escalations
SET
  status       = 'taken_over',
  resolved_by  = $2,
  resolved_at  = NOW(),
  updated_at   = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::uuid;

-- Pause the lead's sequence so AI stops sending
UPDATE sequences s
SET status = 'paused', updated_at = NOW()
FROM leads l
WHERE s.id = l.sequence_id
  AND l.id = $3::uuid
  AND s.status = 'active';

-- Flag lead as human-owned
UPDATE leads
SET status = 'human_owned', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $3::uuid;

INSERT INTO worker_events (worker_id, event_type, payload, created_at)
VALUES (
  (SELECT id FROM workers WHERE worker_type = 'agent-x' LIMIT 1),
  'escalation.resolved',
  $1::jsonb,
  NOW()
);

SELECT
  e.id          AS escalation_id,
  e.lead_id,
  e.reason,
  e.created_at,
  e.context,
  l.full_name,
  l.email,
  l.company,
  l.icp_tier    AS tier
FROM escalations e
JOIN leads l ON l.id = e.lead_id
WHERE e.status = 'pending'
  AND e.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '4 hours'
  AND (e.reminder_sent IS NULL OR e.reminder_sent = FALSE)
LIMIT 10;

UPDATE escalations
SET
  reminder_sent    = TRUE,
  reminder_sent_at = NOW(),
  updated_at       = NOW()
WHERE id = $1::uuid;
